assertions: Every AC has a task
Each task traces to a real ID
Tasks are not published to Jira
The skill stops and points to sw-review

cases.prompt: Plan FEAT-001 after the story changed since its tasks were written
assertions: check_tasks.py reports the stale spec_hash
The tasks are regenerated, not patched

cases.prompt: Plan FEAT-001 with a Touches path that does not exist
assertions: The check fails on that path
No path is guessed
One worker per feature writes only its own plan and tasks files
The lead runs the write guard, then graph, lint and data export once

cases.prompt: Plan FEAT-001, which needs an API, a refund screen and a pipeline change
assertions: Each task title starts with exactly one layer prefix such as [backend], [frontend] or [devops]
Work for different layers is separate tasks ordered with Depends on, not one mixed task
check_tasks.py passes

cases.prompt: Plan a feature whose story lists a mockup ASSET-001 in UI/UX
assertions: Every frontend, mobile and design task has a Visuals line naming the mockup or diagram it builds
Done when names the state or screen the visual shows
A state needed by an AC but missing from the visual becomes a question, not a guess
A frontend task without Visuals makes check_tasks.py exit 1
Reads the plan backlog from the board instead of asking which feature
Lists the accepted features without a current plan in one table, started ones first
Plans them together, one worker per feature, and the lead runs graph, lint and export once
A feature that is not accepted is listed as skipped with its reason and is not planned
Does not offer publication as a next step
